dana: Heads-up: noticed cost attribution numbers don't match the Console badge after the sampling change. The badge shows near-zero for many models.
rachel: Which badge? the small "Estimated cost" top-right?
dana: Yep. It seems sampling default dropped from 0.1 -> 0.01 in runtime v2.2. That reduces attributed tokens in our examples. Console docs still show the old numbers.
oliver: Oof. We should update the quickstart and add a short explanation under "Cost attribution" explaining sampling and how to set `trace_sampling` in presets.
dana: Agreed. Can someone open a docs PR with two things: 1) update badge example values to match sampled expectations, 2) show how to opt into full attribution for tests.
rachel: I'll take it. Plan: add a small YAML snippet and a Python SDK snippet that sets `trace_sampling: 1.0` for CI runs. Also add a note that production should keep sampling to control costs.
docs-bot: lint/links-checker started for PR #10021 by rachel
ux-bot: accessibility check: screenshot `cost-badge.png` alt text missing; recommend "Estimated cost badge showing $12.34 for last 24h"
oliver: Also add a tiny formula showing how sampled counts map to estimated tokens: `estimated_tokens = observed_tokens / sampling_rate` so readers understand the scale-up.
rachel: Will include that and a worked example. For example: observed=120 tokens @ 0.01 => estimated 120/0.01 = 12000 tokens.
dana: Nice. Also please add a small section about sampling bias for low-traffic models (note that very few sampled requests can skew percentages).
docs-bot: example-sniffer job failed: missing `presets: true` frontmatter on `console/quickstart.md` (line 7)
rachel: Adding frontmatter fixes. Also including a short `presets` YAML showing `trace_sampling: 1.0` under `test-presets.yaml`.
oliver: Could add a Node one-liner for CI: `await redwood.tracing.setSampling({ rate: 1.0 })` — keep it pseudo but accurate.
rachel: Added Node and Python examples, updated badge screenshot alt text, included the sampling formula and a migration anchor `#sampling-explain`. Pushed branch `docs/sampling-badge-fix`.
